review_method: Independently read the full actual source text, every exact target unit, particular category and complete rationale for all 142 rows. Chapter 6 was displayed separately in full; changed rows were then displayed again as seven full final source-target-category-rationale triples.

Supplementary passage context was read for Luke 1:39-56 and 2:46-52; John 12:23-28; Psalms 112; Jeremiah 9:20-23; 1 Kings 2:26-35; 2 Kings 21:10-15; Genesis 30:1,22-24 and 35:16-20; Exodus 15:1-3; Leviticus 3:1-5; Deuteronomy 18:1-5; Numbers 6:1-5, 30:7-15, 4:5-6 and 4:15-20; Joshua 7:2-6; 2 Samuel 6:1-11; and 1 Samuel 7:1. Full retained targets outside these context ranges were read within their individual triples.

Verified all 140 ordered source references against the independently inventoried original edition. Preserved one portion, the servant accuser, three-year-old calf, Ephoud bar, Eli ninety and twenty years, Ashkelon, gold seats, both reported death numbers and Aminadab. No harmonization or new linguistic or medical interpretation claimed.

Fetched fifteen raw pinned source-book objects independently; recomputed Git blob SHA1 and raw SHA256 and compared complete parsed objects with the local passage cache. Cache byte differences are retained honestly in the separate pin manifest. No technical check contributes completed-review credit.
